title: Grateful Dead Live at Harding Theater on 1971-11-07
lineage: Akai GX636 direct tape head output  > Bottlehead tube tape pre w/a pair of Telefunken tubes circa 1960  > Apogee Mini Me 24/96  > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering  > FLAC
source: FM MR @ 3/ 3.4 ips(Peter Kafer?)>R @ 3 & 3/4 ips(Will Boswell)

ai_review.summary: Excellent FM broadcast of a high‑energy 1971 show with smoking Cumberland Blues and a barn‑burning Saturday Night/NFA combo.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the crystal‑clear FM source, calling it one of the best recordings of 1971. The performance is described as “high energy” with standout moments like a scorching "Cumberland Blues" and the legendary Not Fade Away > Good… > Not Fade Away sequence, plus a barn‑burner Saturday Night. Keith Godchaux’s fresh presence on keyboards adds an extra spark to the night.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews give 5 stars, praising both the musical performance and the flawless FM recording; consistent high praise yields a near‑perfect rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: FM broadcast is described as crystal‑clear and excellent with no noted flaws or dropouts.

standout_songs: Not Fade Away > Good... > Not Fade Away combo
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows with relentless energy, highlighted by fresh keyboard work and tight transitions, especially in the NFA/Good…/NFA sequence.

band_member_comments.Keys: Keith Godchaux’s first tour brings fresh energy to many songs.
